verdict.rationale: Sensor driver integration is a fair question for a robotics platform that includes Isaac ROS. The evidence shows simulated RTX and physics-based sensors, a ROS bridge, and ROS 2 perception and NITROS acceleration packages. None of it documents ready-made drivers for physical cameras, lidars, IMUs or GPS, or standard sensor message types. Simulated sensors and downstream perception packages are adjacent features, not hardware bring-up drivers, so they earn no credit here.
